scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy:preview: node scripts/preflight-deploy.mjs preview && wrangler deploy --env preview --no-x-provision
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/preflight-deploy.mjs production && wrangler deploy --env production --no-x-provision
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:config && npm run test:migrations && node scripts/expect-deploy-refused.mjs && npm run test:dev
